DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 閉園まであと二十分です。お帰りの道はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: There are twenty minutes until the park closes. Do you know your way out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あと千歩で目標なので、もう一周したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉園前でも一周したい希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm a thousand steps short of my goal, so I'd like to do another lap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want another lap even though closing time is near. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周すると出口まで戻る時間が足りないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you do a lap, you may not have enough time to return to the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 閉園時刻に歩くのをやめるだけでは遅いんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉園までに退園が必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So merely stopping my walk at closing time would be too late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you must leave the park by closing time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。その時刻までに退園をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please be out of the park by that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では出口へ向かいます。途中のベンチで靴ひもを結び直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰路の途中で靴を直せる所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll head to the exit. Can I retie my shoelaces on a bench along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where you can adjust your shoes on the way out. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この先にあります。休憩の時間も含めてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's one just ahead. Allow time for your stop as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこで短く止まります。歩数を増やすために遠回りはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩時間を考慮して遠回りをやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stop there briefly. I won't take a detour to increase my step count.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Allow for the break and abandon the detour. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口はベンチの先を右です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The exit is to the right beyond the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は目標に届かなくても終わりにします。出口へ向かいながら友人に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩数目標より退園を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll finish today even if I don't reach my goal. I'll contact my friend while heading to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize leaving over your step-count goal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。時間に余裕を持ってお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please leave with plenty of time to spare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面が最初に戻りましたね。お手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The screen has returned to the start. May I help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。行先を選んでいる途中でした。切符は買えたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画面が戻った後の購入成立を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do. I was in the middle of choosing my destination. Did the ticket purchase go through?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the purchase succeeded after the screen reset. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お金やカードは入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you inserted money or a card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。条件を読んでいたら画面が消えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未入金の操作経過を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. The screen disappeared while I was reading the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the steps you took without paying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入金前なら購入は完了していません。最初から選び直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you hadn't paid, the purchase isn't complete. Let's make your selections again from the start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急いで押すと間違えそうです。先に買う内容を紙で整理してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入条件を先に整理したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I might make a mistake if I press in a hurry. May I first organize what I want to buy on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to organize the purchase conditions first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。行先と利用日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Tell me your destination and travel date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日、友人の所へ片道で行きます。今日使う券を買いたいのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日片道利用だと具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tomorrow I'm going one way to my friend's place. I don't want a ticket for use today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify that it is a one-way trip tomorrow. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明日利用できる券か、購入方法も含め確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check whether the ticket can be used tomorrow, including how to purchase it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。条件が分かってから操作し、最後の確認画面を読んで払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最終確認後に支払う手順を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll operate it after understanding the conditions, then read the final confirmation screen before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to pay after the final confirmation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順でご案内します。まず利用日の選び方をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll guide you in that order. First I'll explain how to select the travel date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知への回答状況についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about the status of your reply to a notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ネットで書きましたが、また通知が来ました。二重に答えることになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: オンライン回答後の再通知を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I filled it out online, but another notice came. Would replying mean answering twice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about another notice after responding online. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の画面に完了の表示はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did the previous screen show completion?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「下書き保存」と出ました。そこで終わったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下書き保存で終了したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It said 'Save draft.' I thought I was finished there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you stopped after saving a draft. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存と送信は別です。回答を受け付けた記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Saving and submitting are different. I'll check the record of accepted responses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この通知の番号を見てください。未送信なら、保存した内容を見直して送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知番号で受付記録の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please look at this notice number. If I haven't submitted it, can I review and send the saved contents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the acceptance record using the notice number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その操作は案内ページで確認できます。ここで記録も照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check those steps on the instructions page. Let's compare the record here as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。新しく全部入力せず、前の下書きが残っているか先に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残る下書きを先に探すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Instead of entering everything again, I'll first see whether my earlier draft remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to look for the saved draft first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録では回答は未受付です。送信後の完了表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The record shows no response has been accepted. Please check for the completion message after submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未受付と分かりました。下書きから回答を送り、完了画面を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未受付を理解し送信完了を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand it hasn't been accepted. I'll submit my response from the draft and keep a record of the completion screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand that it is unaccepted and confirm submission completion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。送信できない場合は、この窓口へ番号と画面の内容をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If you can't submit, give this counter the number and the details shown on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。受付で配慮が必要なことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Do you need any accommodations at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し耳が聞こえにくいです。放送で名前を呼ばれても気付かないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 放送を聞き逃す可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have some difficulty hearing. I might not notice my name being called over the announcements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you may miss an announcement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 近くでお声がけする方法を担当へ伝えましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Shall I tell the staff to speak to you from nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。正面からゆっくり話してもらえると聞き取りやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正面からゆっくり話す配慮を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. It's easier to hear if someone faces me and speaks slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to be spoken to slowly from in front. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの辺りにお座りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付から見える、この席に座ります。呼ばれたか分からない時は確認していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着席場所と確認の可否を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll sit in this seat visible from reception. May I ask if I'm unsure whether I've been called?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State where you will sit and ask whether you may check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。受付番号も手元に置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Keep your reception number with you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を見せて確認します。大きな声より、顔を見て短く話してもらう方が助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大声より短い対面説明がよいと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show my number to check. Speaking briefly while facing me helps more than speaking loudly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add that a brief face-to-face explanation is better than a loud voice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望も記録します。診療科の担当にも引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record that preference too and pass it to the department staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。聞き取れないまま返事をせず、分からない時は聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 理解できない時は聞き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't answer without hearing clearly; I'll ask again if I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask again when you don't understand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。呼出しの際はこちらからも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll also check with you when calling you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯電話をお持ちですね。拾われたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're holding a mobile phone. Did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。バスの席にありました。運転手さんへ話しましたが、現物は渡していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バスで拾い運転手へ知らせたが未引渡しだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It was on a bus seat. I told the driver, but hadn't handed over the actual phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you found it on a bus and told the driver but had not handed it over. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 伝えた後、携帯はどこにありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where was the phone after you told the driver?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 落とさないよう私のかばんに入れました。そのまま降りてしまい、今気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かばんに入れたまま降りた経緯を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put it in my bag so I wouldn't drop it. I got off with it still there and have just realized.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you got off with the phone still in your bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: バス会社へ引き渡した状態ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it hasn't been handed over to the bus company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。届けたつもりと言いそうでしたが、渡したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届けたつもりと実物の引渡しを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. I nearly said I'd reported it, but I hadn't actually handed it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish thinking you reported it from physically handing it over. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗った便や、運転手へ話した時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know which bus service you took and when you spoke to the driver?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この乗車履歴があります。終点の一つ前で話しました。電話の中身は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 便の記録と話した時点を示し中身は未閲覧と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have this travel record. I spoke at the stop before the terminus. I haven't looked through the phone's contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the trip record and when you spoke, and say you have not viewed the contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過と現物を確認します。バス会社への連絡についても担当にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check those events and the phone itself. Please ask the staff about contacting the bus company as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現物をこちらに渡します。会社には、口頭で知らせただけで持ち帰っていたと説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物を渡しバス会社にも経緯を訂正して説明すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hand the phone over here. I'd like to explain to the company that I only told them verbally and had taken it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the phone and say you will correct and explain the events to the bus company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。実際の引渡しがどこで行われたか、分かるように記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll record clearly where the actual handover occurred.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about mail after moving, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。転居届を出したので、会社にも新しい住所が伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社登録まで変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since I submitted a forwarding notification, will my company also be informed of my new address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the company registration changes too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の転送手続きで、会社の登録住所が変わるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mail forwarding does not change the address registered with your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社への住所変更は自分で連絡するんですね。保険の会社も同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出人別の届出が必要と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to tell my company about the address change myself. Is it the same with my insurance company?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that each sender must be notified separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの差出人へご連絡ください。転送の案内とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please contact each sender. That is separate from the forwarding information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では連絡する相手の一覧を作ります。転送されて来た封筒でも、宛先は古いままなんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転送封筒の住所表示を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll make a list of people to contact. Even on envelopes that are forwarded to me, is the addressee's address still the old one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the address shown on forwarded envelopes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人が旧住所で出した物なら、その記載は残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the sender mailed it to your old address, that wording remains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届いたから変更済みだと思わず、封筒の住所を見て未連絡の所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いた封筒で未変更先を探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume it's updated just because it arrived. I'll look at envelope addresses to find places I haven't contacted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use received envelopes to find registrations not yet changed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 転送期間にも限りがあります。案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The forwarding period is also limited. Please take this information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期間を確認して、会社と保険会社へ今日連絡します。転送だけに頼らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転送期間内に差出人へ変更を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the period and contact my company and insurance company today. I'll make sure not to rely only on forwarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Notify senders of the change within the forwarding period. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。新住所の受取環境も整えておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please also make sure you can receive mail properly at your new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどのお手続きについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the procedure you completed earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。控えの電話番号が一桁短いです。私が書き忘れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話番号の桁不足を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The telephone number on my receipt is one digit short. I may have forgotten to write it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the phone number is missing a digit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正しい番号を確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have something showing the correct number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の電話の表示がこれです。末尾の前に七が入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正しい番号の資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the display on my own phone. A seven belongs before the final digit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show material indicating the correct number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申請内容と照合します。登録完了前なら訂正を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll compare it with the application. We can check the correction if registration is not yet complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もう登録されていた場合も直せますか。電話がつながらなくなるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録後でも直せるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can it be corrected if it's already registered too? I'm worried calls won't connect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether it can be corrected after registration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況に応じて変更手続きをご案内します。まず現時点の登録を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain the change procedure according to its status. First I'll check the current registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。番号を全部読み上げるので、直す一桁だけでなく全体を照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更箇所だけでなく全桁照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'll read out the whole number, so I'd like to compare the entire number rather than just the one corrected digit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to compare every digit rather than only the changed part. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。正しい番号で申請を確認し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll recheck the application using the correct number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。新しい控えを受け取ったら、最初から最後まで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正控えを全体で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is the number. When I receive the new receipt, I'll check it from beginning to end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the entire corrected receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正した控えをお渡しします。内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the corrected receipt. Please check its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「要加熱」とありますが、レンジで少し温めれば食べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 要加熱を軽い温めでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says 'requires cooking,' but can I eat it after warming it a little in the microwave?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether light warming is enough for a product requiring cooking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 裏面の調理方法もご覧ください。「フライパンで中心まで加熱」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please read the cooking instructions on the back too. It says 'cook through to the center in a frying pan.'

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 温かくするだけとは違うんですね。家にはレンジしかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家の調理器具の制約を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So that differs from just making it warm. I only have a microwave at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your home cooking-equipment limitation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品は、表示の方法で調理する物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This product must be prepared using the method on its label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レンジで調理できる別の商品はありますか。帰宅してそのまま食べるつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電子レンジ対応の代替品を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is there another product I can cook in the microwave? I intended to eat it as soon as I got home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Look for a microwave-compatible alternative. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは電子レンジの加熱時間が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one has microwave heating times printed on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ワット数で時間が違いますね。私のは五百ワットなので、その欄を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅のワット数に合う時間を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The time differs by wattage. Mine is five hundred watts, so I'll read that column.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the time matching your microwave's wattage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋を外すかどうかも表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the label to see whether the bag should be removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらに変えます。指定の容器へ移す説明も読んでから温めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器の指示を確認して商品を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll switch to this one. I'll read the instructions for transferring it to the specified container before heating too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the container instructions and change products. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。購入後も包装の調理表示を残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Keep the cooking instructions on the packaging after purchase as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子さんとご一緒ですか。今の放送は聞こえましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you with your child? Did you hear the announcement just now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中だけ聞こえました。「広場」とありましたが、遊んでいてよいんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞き取れなかった放送内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only heard part of it. It mentioned the plaza; is it okay to keep playing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the announcement you couldn't hear clearly. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雨雲が近づいているので、広場から建物側へ移動する案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rain clouds are approaching, so it asks people to move from the plaza toward the buildings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子供は奥で遊んでいます。まず呼び戻して、一緒に移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 離れた子供を呼び戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child is playing farther in. I'll first call them back and we'll move together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will call back your child who is farther away. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。別々に動かないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Make sure you don't move separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻って来ました。雨宿りできる所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合流後に雨宿り場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child is back. Where can we shelter from the rain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to shelter after reuniting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理棟の前の屋根へご案内します。こちらの舗装路を通ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll guide you to the roofed area in front of the administration building. Use this paved path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 木の下ではなく、屋根まで歩きます。子供の荷物も持てました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木の下を避け荷物をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll walk to the roofed area, rather than stand under a tree. I've also gathered my child's belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid standing under trees and gather your belongings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 濡れる前に移動しましょう。道が滑り始めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's move before you get wet. The path is starting to get slippery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 走らず手をつないで向かいます。次の放送もそこで聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手をつないで移動し続報を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll hold hands and go without running. We'll listen to the next announcement there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Move holding hands and listen for further announcements. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。管理棟の前で状況をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We'll explain the situation in front of the administration building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その箱はお一人で運ばれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you carrying that box alone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。重いので、このエスカレーターに置いて運びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い箱を移動する希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's heavy, so I'd like to put it on this escalator to transport it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your wish to move the heavy box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱が安定しないと危険です。エレベーターの経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's dangerous if the box is unstable. I'll show you the elevator route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 助かります。階段を通らずホームまで行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段を避けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: That helps. Can I get to the platform without using stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can avoid stairs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この通路から行けますが、途中に狭い扉があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can go through this passage, but there is a narrow door along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱の幅が広いです。無理に押し込まず、先に通れるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 狭い扉を通れるか先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The box is wide. I'd like to check first whether it fits, rather than force it through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check first whether it fits through the narrow door. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 幅を見ますので、通路の脇に置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the width. Could you put it at the side of the passage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここに置きます。箱の上に載せた袋も下ろします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を脇に置いて上の袋を下ろす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put it here. I'll take down the bag sitting on top of the box too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put the box to the side and remove the bag on top. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この大きさなら通れます。台車の使用については駅の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This size will fit. For using a cart, please check the station's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 台車は使わず、持ち直して運びます。列車一本を見送っても急がないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち直し列車に急がず移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't use a cart; I'll adjust my grip and carry it. I'll avoid rushing even if I have to let one train go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Adjust your grip and move without rushing for a train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。前が見える持ち方で、エレベーターへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Carry it in a way that lets you see ahead, and proceed to the elevator.
